title: Grateful Dead Live at Gizah Sound and Light Theater on 1978-09-15
lineage: MAC >> Nakamichi CR7a => Korg MR-1000 >> DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] >> Korg MR-1000 => Korg AudioGate >> WAV [24/96] > flac16

ai_review.summary: Decent recording that captures a mixed‑energy show – some fans love the space jams while others feel the performance fell flat.
ai_review.review: The three reviews paint a split picture: one reviewer criticizes the band’s lackluster, jet‑lagged playing and notes audible audience chatter despite calling the tape "nice," while two reviewers rave about the transcendent “space” vibe of the night. Recording quality is generally praised as clear, but no concrete details on source type are given.

ai_rating.rationale: Two highly positive reviews (5★) highlight the show’s spacey energy, offset by one low‑rating review (2★) that calls the performance weak; recording is described as "nice" with no major flaws, yielding an overall rating just above 4.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a 'nice' recording; audience chatter audible during jams suggests an audience or matrix source with clear but ambient‑filled sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific setlist comments; reviewers focus on overall vibe—one finds the night’s energy lacking, two celebrate the spacey improvisations.
